svg.title: Mell security model
svg.desc: The lethal trifecta of private data, untrusted content and external communication; Mell blocks external communication while a turn is tainted. Six defence layers: permission engine, content-based taint, approval binding, pinned tool definitions, no listening ports, supply-chain controls.
svg.text: BLOCKED WHILE A TURN IS TAINTED

g.text: The model proposes; deterministic code decides.
Any file, page or document taints the turn.
Single use, re-verified: what runs is what you approved.
First-party only; changes disable the tool.
Lockfile only, no install scripts, pinned actions.
